metadata.name: Sediment elemental concentration measurements from Station SO268_043MUC
metadata.description: This dataset contains sediment elemental concentration measurements from a single station (SO268_043MUC) in the 'German collector trial pre-impact' area. It includes measurements for various elements such as Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, and Ti, along with their relative errors and replicate measurements. The data was collected at a fixed location and time, with sediment depth ranging from 0.0625 to 0.225.
